{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool crepe trousers, straight high-waisted cut, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey (#3B3F45), lined wool blend

Fine merino turtleneck, slim fit, hip length, ivory (#EDE6D6), 100% extra-fine merino wool

Textured wool-blend blazer, single-breasted, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, dark navy (#1F2A44), herringbone wool with a soft lining

Long tailored coat, single-breasted, knee-to-mid-calf length, camel (#B58A5A), dense wool-cashmere blend, worn over the blazer

Ankle boots, low block heel, almond toe, rubber lug sole, black (#1A1A1A), waterproof treated leather with warm lining and salt-resistant finish

Thermal tights under the trousers, sheer-opaque, black (#111111), fine knit with brushed interior

Scarf, wide and generous, oatmeal (#CFC3AE), soft lambswool

Gloves, slim cut, wrist length, dark brown (#4A3426), lined leather

Knit beanie, close fit, charcoal (#3B3F45), ribbed wool with fleece lining

Structured tote bag, medium size, fits a laptop and a folder, black (#1A1A1A), grained leather

This outfit works because every piece is classic and quiet in tone, so it reads as neat and professional at the office. The layers of merino, blazer and a dense wool-cashmere coat keep her warm over a 20-minute walk in deep frost, while the thermal tights add warmth without bulk. The waterproof lug-sole boots with a salt-resistant finish grip snowy pavements and handle road salt, and the low block heel keeps the walk comfortable. Once she takes off the coat, scarf and beanie, the turtleneck and blazer with trousers are already office-ready."}
